class.name: fr3_mating_controllers/CartesianImpedanceStrokeController
class.description: Cartesian-impedance equilibrium tracker for the connector insertion stroke: tool-frame stiffness (soft lateral, firm axial), slew-limited setpoint from ~/equilibrium_pose, nullspace posture hold, coriolis feed-forward. float_mode:=true sends coriolis only (commissioning).
